## DG6 round 11: domain review verdict is **PASS** (with one new Low finding)

**Candidate check:** the candidate ID recomputes to `sha256:c45d73b8…ad2b` over 2,769 files, both in the repository and in a complete clone of `33db1a46`. HEAD is `4492cdfd0`, not the source commit: it is the freeze commit, and it only adds the assignments, the candidate manifest and `stages.json`, all excluded from the candidate ID. So the frozen candidate is the one assigned. The historical validators for DG5 to DG1 pass, and so does `--register DG6`.

### F-DG6-640 (Medium, from round 10): CLOSED_VERIFIED
- **API:** I ported my round-10 probe to the new token form, made its soft assertions hard and added new cases. A token copied into a draft at the same row version is now refused (422 `restricted_token_stale`) and nothing is stored, whether it comes from:
  - the published version of the same rule;
  - another rule;
  - a discarded draft.
- **The tag itself:**
  - It matches the HMAC formula in ADR-0051, which I computed independently from the database key.
  - It differs per row and per revision.
  - The key never appears in any served response or in the audit trail.
  - Forged, retired, upper-case and wrong-length tokens are all refused.
  - All 63 tests pass. Node 22.22.0 and Node 24 give identical results (the assignment names 22.22.2; 22.22.0 is what is installed).
- **Real UI, EN and AR:** through the real publish flow, pasting the published version's token into draft v2 is refused. The draft stays [P, H], never [P, H, H].
- **Mutants:** reverting the tag to a version-only value broke 7 of 16 tests; removing the tag comparison broke 14 of 21. Both were caught by my probe and by the candidate's own z14/z15 tests. The file was restored afterwards.

### New finding
- **F-DG6-700, Low, non-blocking, owner frontend-ux-engineer (REQ-S15-011).** When that paste is refused, the editor tells the author in EN and AR: "This rule changed after you opened it … re-apply your change". That is untrue: the rule did not change. The editor also hides the corrected problem text that this repair added. Re-applying gives the same message again, so the author loops. The stored data is correct. I rated it Low by the F-DG4-160 precedent (untrue user-facing text). I did not accept it as an observation, because the fix is small.

### Rest of the review (all pass)
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| Register integration files | 97/97 files, 1,225 tests, plus 1 pre-existing todo (V14 shows the same one) |
| Unit | 38 files |
| Domain e2e, EN and AR | 176 passed, then 90 passed with 18 skips (the 9 detail screens per language that the axe spec marks NOT SCANNED, as disclosed in the REQ-S15-012 note) |
| Demo-stack walkthroughs | 6 passed |
| Frontend P6 specs | 58 passed |
| Build | all steps exit 0 |

The screens I inspected show the right state. A failed connector opens one exception, and its KPI shows Stale with last value 250.75 dated 2026-01-31, never zero or green. Unknown counts never show as 0. The Arabic 360 px approval screen is right-to-left with no horizontal overflow.

I accept D-194 to D-196, D-199 item 2, D-202, D-203 to D-205, D-229 and D-228 (4).

### Disclosed in the record
- **My probe bug:** the first Node 22 run failed one of my own probe's assertions. It checked for the text "1:", which a random hex tag can contain. I fixed the assertion and re-ran both Node versions green.
- **My disk cleanup:** free disk fell to 918 MB, so I deleted delivery evidence from my clone only. One unit test read a file from it and failed with "file not found"; I restored the file and the re-run passed.
- **Cleanup refused:** a bulk delete of scratch directories was refused. I deleted my own clone and screenshot directories by explicit path. Leftover test-run temp directories remain in my private scratch directory, which the runner removes when the run ends.

I granted no business, Finance or IT approval, and product gate G6 does not imply DG7.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG6/round-11/`:
- domain-reviewer.json
- domain-reviewer.verifications.json
- domain-reviewer.findings.json

Evidence is under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/domain/round-11/`.
